visual_rules.rule: When the masterbrand anchors owned web UI, use the supplied black transparent wordmark against quiet pale or white channel surfaces so the mark remains small, direct, and unornamented.
visual_rules.scope: Current official US website header; no public identity manual was found.

visual_rules.rule: When presenting fragrance families or packaging, keep utilitarian black-on-white label information legible and pair it with clear glass, uncoated kraft board, or restrained neutral materials because specification-like labeling carries product identity.

When showing craft, foreground a worker, hands, ingredient, or tool in the act of making and tolerate motion blur, grain, silhouette, and low light because process is represented as lived work rather than polished demonstration.
visual_rules.scope: Official Craftspeople film posters; film-wide motion grammar remains unverified.

visual_rules.rule: When translating product into an editorial collection tile, isolate a short product family on tactile neutral surfaces and add one hand or use gesture so the image conveys choice or application without becoming a conventional lifestyle scene.

When extending the brand into editorial content, make a physical newspaper the focal object and place dense black typographic composition against concrete, metal, pavement, rope, and wood because the editorial identity depends on friction between print culture and urban material reality.

When representing place and service, preserve the laboratory/store as part of the existing street fabric with worn metal, glass, concrete, exposed equipment, and modest signage because the environment communicates working-lab authenticity rather than pristine boutique spectacle.
visual_rules.scope: Official Roots image of the first lab; broader store-network consistency is unresolved.

visual_rules.rule: When a desktop navigation category expands, lead with one square photographic key visual and an uppercase text overlay while the adjacent column carries the deeper link hierarchy, concentrating image impact without replacing the functional menu.
visual_rules.scope: Current official desktop navigation markup and assets; responsive rendered states were not captured.

gaps: No current public first-party identity manual or explicit masterbrand color specification was located in the rapid window.
The official wordmark file is verified, but alternate lockups, clear-space rules, and authorized monochrome variants remain unresolved.
Webfonts are exposed by first-party CSS; licensing and redistribution permissions were not established, so no font files were copied.
Responsive menu behavior and motion were inspected only from static source; no screenshots, browser automation, or extracted video frames were used.
The Roots image establishes one first-lab environment but does not prove consistency across the global store network.
Film posters support still-image craft language; edit rhythm, sound, and full motion grammar remain unverified.
Image authorship beyond Le Labo's first-party publication was not credited in the inspected pages.
The upstream URL for EV-LL-012 ends in .png but returned JPEG bytes; the local extension was normalized to .jpg and the hash records the received bytes.
